title: Scale plan
description: Output of the scale-planner skill. One entry per component found in the input design. Every later stage (script, scenes, fact-check) reads this file.

audience.description: Who watches, and what they already know.

input.description: Path or short description of the design that was planned.

scale_range.description: The scale span the explanation covers, in the workload's own units.

job.description: What the component must do, with no product names.

contract.description: Properties any substitute must keep (ordering, durability, consistency, latency budget, ...). A substitute that breaks one of these is not a valid substitute.

axes.description: Every scale axis that was considered for this component, with its value in the input design.

binding_axis.description: The one axis that forces the choice. Must be one of the names in axes.

options.description: One entry per scale band. Length is whatever the component needs: 1 for keep is normal.

migration.description: What changes in code, data, and operations when moving between options.

teaching_moment.description: The single insight this segment exists to teach.

catalog.description: Catalog file consulted (for example crossovers/latency-path.md), or 'uncatalogued'.

band.description: The scale band where this option fits, in the binding axis's units.

cost.description: What this option costs: money, operations, team skill, flexibility.

breaks_when.description: The condition on the binding axis where this option stops meeting the contract. null for the last option or for keep.

ref.description: URL or citation. Required when kind is source.

conditions.description: Hardware, payload size, configuration, or team assumptions behind the numbers.
